craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. Dye image left standing (row 10); end-weight nowhere. Rejected: (a) explaining upādhi → killed: never gloss load terms in song. (b) softening nowhere → killed: the verses whole point is the nowhere. Read aloud: STEEPED in THE-work-ing-SHINE-dye … YET-diff-er FROM the-NON-ex-IST-ent NOWHERE.

lines: Steeped in the working-shine dye, the existent would subsist
by its own form — yet differ from the non-existent nowhere.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam arthakriyābhāsopādhisaṃbhedam āgataḥ sann arthaḥ syāt svarūpeṇa nāsatas tu viśiṣyate

reads_against.argmap: Does function-conditioned being escape the collapse? → Borrowed dye is no distinction: conditioned being differs from non-being nowhere.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
